summaryZh: Saier 实验室研究细菌的转录与代谢调控、转运蛋白演化，以及转座子介导的定向突变。实验室采用生化、分子遗传学、生理学和生物信息学方法，并创建和维护转运蛋白分类数据库 TCDB。
researchQuestions: 细菌的转录与代谢如何受到调控？
转座子介导的定向突变如何发生？
topics: 转座子介导的定向突变
转运蛋白分类数据库 TCDB

evidence.quote: Dr. Milton Saier is the head of the laboratory.
Our laboratory takes a multidisciplinary approach to science, using biochemical, molecular genetic, physiological, and bioinformatic approaches.

We have three primary research interests, one concerned with transcriptional and metabolic regulation in bacteria, a second with transport protein evolution, and a third with the recently identified process of transposon-mediated directed mutation.

We also created and now maintain the Transporter Classification DataBase ( TCDB ), which was adopted by the International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology ( IUBMB ) as the primary source of information relating to molecular transport.
